title: [SUBS] Obsession (2026) - Movie Streaming @ HBO Max
body:
Deal: [SUBS] Obsession (2026) - Movie Streaming @ HBO Max

[Hiphopopotamus] While you wait go (re)watch the excellent Little Shop of Horrors .
[BestTechAdvisor] Better yet, watch the Obsession director's YouTube Channel, it's bloody hilarious.
[Vand] Incredible movie. Highly rec even if you're not necessarily a "horror" fan.
[imahippy] Watched on stremio ages ago, was pretty decent
[dealsforlife] Personally, I didn't think this movie was worth the hype. Don't get me wrong, it's still a good movie and definitely worth a watch.
I'd recommend something like Hokum & Leviticus (creepy) and Bring Her Back.
Waiting for the downvotes from Obsession fans.
[Pacify] I did like Hokum, but personally I think Obsession was just much better written film.
But I could be biased, I liked Curry Barker's YT before Obsession ever came out
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] t's still a good movie and definitely worth a watch.
I'd recommend something like Hokum & Leviticus (creepy) and Bring Her Back.
they can all be equally good? because movies are subjective.
I have been looking forward to Obsession and Hokum too (loved all Damian mcarthy movies). and agree Bring her back was amayzing!!
[IpGem] Agreed, hooked me up initially but the ending could've been better imo
[SavingUpForAnXbox] Confirmed to be aus HBO MAX? Backrooms was chucked up here a few weeks ago and never came
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] thank you so much!
I actually posted asking about when Backrooms is coming to HBO in forums, but obv more users active on the deal side of ozb.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] Backrooms was chucked up here a few weeks ago and never came
yes sometimes Justwatch can be wrong, so helps to confirm with someone who has HBO sub to confirm they can see and add the "Coming soon on __" trailer to the wishlist first.
seems like some subs are pulling a bit of a tricky (so far I noticed this happening with Binge and HBO), where they put up just the trailer, and because its available to be added to your wishlist, justwatch thinks it's the actual movie coming on XX/X, when it's not it's just the trailer.
[lakers1222] Btw this movie (profanity) me up for weeks
[BadGiraffe] Did you coincidently have a kid silently stand next to your bed in the morning waiting for you to wake up… and you open your eyes… and you freaking lose it?
He learned some new words that day.
[CrocDundee] For a low budget, no-name cast movie, this was unbelievably good! The lead female actor was outstanding imo. Well worth the watch if you like this kind of thing.
[Nillionaire] She has since deservedly become a big name and set to play Rogue in MCU's X Men reboot 🙂
